name: Recover stalled approvals
eligibility_basis: Eligible for requests still pending after the assigned approver becomes unavailable. Existing delegates already handle some cases.
effort_basis: Workflow state, admin UI, authorization, audit and retries

name: Bundle comment notifications
eligibility_basis: Requires repeated non-critical comment alerts and an eligible delivery preference.
effort_basis: Digest scheduling, preferences, delivery and QA

name: Show sync status and recovery
eligibility_basis: Helps diagnose lag and retry failures. Duplicated writes need connector fixes.
effort_basis: Connector state, controls, idempotency review and QA

name: Make large exports resumable
eligibility_basis: Covers interrupted CSV jobs. Schema and formatting defects need separate investigation.
effort_basis: Async jobs, progress UI, retention and test matrix

name: Preview guest access
eligibility_basis: Addresses role configuration confusion. Suspected exposure follows incident response.
effort_basis: Permission resolution, preview UI and adversarial QA

name: Boost exact task matches
eligibility_basis: Applies to exact titles and IDs. Index freshness has its own root cause.
effort_basis: Ranking, relevance checks and rollout monitoring
